newyear.name: Countdown to midnight
newyear.description: A big countdown to midnight on a matrix of the show, the last ten seconds huge, then fireworks, "Happy New Year!" and a fanfare; the phones count down with it
newyear.intro: A big countdown to midnight on a matrix of the show: from a few minutes before, the matrix shows the time left (the last ten seconds as one huge number); at zero, fireworks, "Happy New Year!" and a fanfare. With the date empty it counts down to the next 1 January at 00:00 (this computer's clock); pick another date and time, every day, or press Start for a countdown of a few minutes. The visitors' page counts down with the lights. Pick the matrix, then Save.

wedding.name: Live wedding countdown
wedding.description: A big countdown on a matrix of the show to the couple's entrance or the cake, then twinkling lights, a message and a fanfare; the guests' phones count down with it
wedding.intro: A big countdown on a matrix of the show to the big moment: the couple's entrance, the first dance, cutting the cake. Pick the date and time, or choose "Only when I press Start" and press Start when the moment is near (or wire a show button to the input "start"). At zero: twinkling lights, a message and a fanfare. The guests' page counts down with the lights. Pick the matrix, then Save.

baptism.name: Live baptism countdown
baptism.description: A big countdown on a matrix of the show to the moment of the party, then colour bursts, a welcome and a fanfare; the guests' phones count down with it
baptism.intro: A big countdown on a matrix of the show to a moment of the party (the cake, the entrance). Pick the date and time, or choose "Only when I press Start" and press Start when the moment is near. At zero: colour bursts, a welcome and a fanfare. The guests' page counts down with the lights. Pick the matrix, then Save.

easter.name: Countdown to Easter
easter.description: A big countdown to Easter Sunday on a matrix of the show, then colour bursts, "Happy Easter!" and a fanfare; the phones count down with it
easter.intro: A big countdown on a matrix of the show: with the date empty, to the next Easter Sunday at 00:00 (worked out each year); or pick a date and time (the egg hunt!), every day, or press Start. At zero: colour bursts, "Happy Easter!" and a fanfare. The visitors' page counts down with the lights. Pick the matrix, then Save.

halloween.name: Countdown to Halloween
halloween.description: A big countdown to Halloween on a matrix of the show, then colour bursts, "Happy Halloween!" and a fanfare; the phones count down with it
halloween.intro: A big countdown on a matrix of the show: with the date empty, to the next 31 October at 00:00 (set a time like 19:00 for the start of trick-or-treating); or pick a date, every day, or press Start. At zero: colour bursts, "Happy Halloween!" and a fanfare. The visitors' page counts down with the lights. Pick the matrix, then Save.

thanksgiving.name: Countdown to Thanksgiving
thanksgiving.description: A big countdown to Thanksgiving on a matrix of the show, then colour bursts, "Happy Thanksgiving!" and a fanfare; the phones count down with it
thanksgiving.intro: A big countdown on a matrix of the show: with the date empty, to the next Thanksgiving (the fourth Thursday of November) at 00:00; set a time for dinner, or pick a date, every day, or press Start. At zero: colour bursts, "Happy Thanksgiving!" and a fanfare. The visitors' page counts down with the lights. Pick the matrix, then Save.

carnival.name: Countdown to Carnival
carnival.description: A big countdown to Carnival on a matrix of the show, then fireworks, "Happy Carnival!" and a fanfare; the phones count down with it
carnival.intro: A big countdown on a matrix of the show: with the date empty, to the next Carnival Tuesday at 00:00 (47 days before Easter, worked out each year); or pick a date and time (the parade!), every day, or press Start. At zero: fireworks, "Happy Carnival!" and a fanfare. The visitors' page counts down with the lights. Pick the matrix, then Save.

valentines.name: Countdown to Valentine's Day
valentines.description: A big countdown to Valentine's Day on a matrix of the show, then twinkling lights, a message and a fanfare; the phones count down with it
valentines.intro: A big countdown on a matrix of the show: with the date empty, to the next 14 February at 00:00; or pick a date and time, every day, or press Start (a proposal?). At zero: twinkling lights, "Happy Valentine's Day!" and a fanfare. The visitors' page counts down with the lights. Pick the matrix, then Save.

birthday.name: Live birthday countdown
birthday.description: A big countdown on a matrix of the show to the cake, then fireworks, "Happy Birthday!" and a fanfare; the guests' phones count down with it
birthday.intro: A big countdown on a matrix of the show to the big moment of the party: the cake, the birthday itself. Pick the date and time, or choose "Only when I press Start" and press Start when the cake is coming (or wire a show button to the input "start"). At zero: fireworks, "Happy Birthday!" and a fanfare. The guests' page counts down with the lights. Pick the matrix, then Save.

childrensday.name: Countdown to Children's Day
childrensday.description: A big countdown to Children's Day on a matrix of the show, then a rainbow, a message and a fanfare; the phones count down with it
childrensday.intro: A big countdown on a matrix of the show: with the date empty, to the next 1 June at 00:00 (pick your own country's day if it is another one); or a date and time, every day, or press Start. At zero: a rainbow, "Happy Children's Day!" and a fanfare. The visitors' page counts down with the lights. Pick the matrix, then Save.

july4.name: Countdown to the fireworks
july4.description: A big countdown to the 4th of July fireworks on a matrix of the show, then fireworks, a message and a fanfare; the phones count down with it
july4.intro: A big countdown on a matrix of the show: with the date and time empty, to the next 4 July at 21:00 (when the fireworks start; set your own time); or pick a date, every day, or press Start. At zero: fireworks, "Happy 4th of July!" and a fanfare. The visitors' page counts down with the lights. Pick the matrix, then Save.
